scope: Official confirmation with frozen fitted vectors. No gradient steps and no model selection. Independent starting headings conditional on the fixed probe recipes.

frozen_parameters.baseline: Original hand-set values for each arm, re-scored on the fresh panels

panels.scheme: One uniform heading in each of sixteen equal-width sectors per panel. Same discrete yaw schedules, goal offsets, horizons and sizes as FIT2.

gates.native_dark_turn_regression_over_3_deg: Report as a trade-off, outside pass predicate

dark_turn_reference: Native hand-set median on the same fresh dark-turn panel. Also report delta versus the historical native hand-set median.

ceiling_diagnosis.reference: Four-second clamped convergence count for the same arm and parameters, on the legacy clamped panel. This is an empirical reference across two panels with different goal offsets.
ceiling_diagnosis.stable: Tail absolute error range <=1 deg, final commanded yaw <=0.05 deg per step in magnitude
ceiling_diagnosis.approaching: Late signed absolute-error slope < -1 deg/s and net absolute-error drop >1 deg
ceiling_diagnosis.departing: Late signed absolute-error slope > 1 deg/s and net absolute-error rise >1 deg
ceiling_diagnosis.slope: Least squares over post-update steps 61–80, 0.05 seconds per step
ceiling_diagnosis.other: Unresolved when stable, approaching and departing criteria all fail
ceiling_diagnosis.angle_bins: Original signed offsets -120, -65, -30, +30, +65, +120 degrees; report misses out of 16 each
